verses.Lamentations 3:22: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

verses.Lamentations 3:23: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

verses.Matthew 6:11: Give us today our daily bread.
verses.2 Timothy 4:7: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
